sit.title: Sit-down recordings
sit.when: Your calibration clip and the monthly recordings
steps: Set it on a small tripod or a stack of books, not in your hand.
Frame yourself from mid-chest up, centered, with a little space above your head.
Face a window or a lamp. Avoid a bright window behind you.
Turn off fans and music if you can. Outdoors, a clip-on mic makes a big difference.
Talk to it like a client across the table. Pause a second before and after each answer; restarts are fine.
sit.setting: One-time setting: if your phone offers it, record in 4K at 30 fps (on iPhone: Settings > Camera > Record Video).

clips.title: Listing and open-house clips
clips.when: Walkthroughs, open houses and anything worth sharing
steps: Hold it with both hands, elbows in, and walk slowly.
Several short clips beat one long one: each room, the view, the street.
Daylight and lights on make every room look bigger.
Get a quick OK before filming people or anything personal in a seller's home.

guide.send: Upload the original from your camera roll through your link. No trimming, filters or captions; we take care of all of that.

approvals: we send you one preview link on WhatsApp, with email as a backup, showing next week's posts: each video, its title and caption, where it goes and when.
mark each one approve, change or skip. A quick comment is enough.
small caption fixes we make and confirm with you. A change to a video comes back to you within one business day.
we send one friendly reminder and hold anything you haven't approved.
same-day clips come to you on WhatsApp as they're ready. Reply OK or a change and we post within a couple of hours.
the sample edits from your calibration clip lock in captions, music and your on-screen name, so weekly reviews are only about what you say.
afterMonth: Once you're happy with the quality, we phase in automatic approval. Shorts cut from videos you've already approved go first, then everything else. You'll still get the weekly preview, so you can stop anything before it posts.
hour: We send about 12 questions drawn from your own answers. You record on your phone, in one sitting or a few, and upload through your link. No scripts.
